environment.description: Same Flask application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB. The ALB target group has a request routing rule that applies a regex constraint on query string parameters via an ALB listener rule condition: any query-string key 'limit' must match the pattern ^[0-9]{1,3}$ (enforced via ALB advanced request routing with query_string conditions). Additionally, the ECS task role has an IAM permission boundary that denies s3:*, rds:*, and the task runs with a read-only root filesystem (readonlyRootFilesystem: true in the task definition) with the database mounted on a tmpfs volume at /var/lib/app/ with noexec. The ALB also has a listener rule that returns HTTP 400 for any request where the query string total length exceeds 128 characters.

config.load_balancer: AWS ALB with advanced listener rules

alb_listener_rule_1.condition: query_string key=limit, value pattern does NOT match ^[0-9]{1,3}$
alb_listener_rule_1.note: ALB query_string condition uses exact key matching and value regex

alb_listener_rule_2.note: Prevents long injection payloads in any query parameter

config.network: VPC private subnet, ALB in public subnet
